definitions.explanation: To a striking or notable degree. The adverbial form of the i-adjective 著しい. Used in formal and written contexts to describe changes, differences, or developments that are clearly evident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{著|いちじる}しく⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{著|いちじる}しく⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{公正|こうせい}→公正：01751_kousei⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{著|いちじる}しく⟦{欠|か}く→欠く：13166_kaku⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}→判断：03571_handan⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It was criticized as a judgment that conspicuously lacked fairness.

notes:
The adverbial form of the i-adjective ⟦{著|いちじる}しい→著しい：10421_ichijirushii⟧ (remarkable, conspicuous). Used in formal and written contexts to indicate a striking degree of change or difference.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {著|いちじる}しく⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (increase remarkably)
- {著|いちじる}しく⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (decline significantly)
- {著|いちじる}しく⟦{進歩|しんぽ}→進歩：03265_shinpo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (advance remarkably)
- {著|いちじる}しく⟦{欠|か}く→欠く：13166_kaku⟧ (conspicuously lack)
- {著|いちじる}しく⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧ (differ markedly)

REGISTER:
Primarily used in formal writing: news reports, academic papers, legal documents, and official statements. In legal contexts, {著|いちじる}しく⟦{不当|ふとう}→不当：11319_futou⟧ (grossly unfair) is a standard legal phrase.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧/⟦すごく→すごい：01128_sugoi⟧: very (casual, everyday)
- ⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: extremely (formal but more common)
- {著|いちじる}しく: conspicuously (formal, emphasizes the visible/measurable nature of change)
